gates.requiredScope: Exact intended candidate has clean whitespace, complete path inventory, no protected or generated output, and no placeholders.
gates.rationale: Every delivery candidate requires exact staged-scope proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while this feature changes tracked files.

gates.requiredScope: All Tp7 and Wave5Showcase real app-loop, Description, keyboard, focus, and constrained-layout tests pass in Release.
gates.rationale: Ten visible showcase compositions require direct proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while Wave-5 showcase examples remain in scope.

gates.requiredScope: All ten normal executable projects run the controlled Release smoke path without an implicit build.
gates.rationale: Test construction does not replace proof of normal launch projects.

gates.requiredScope: The complete solution Release test suite passes.
gates.rationale: Shared executable presentation can affect broad example integration.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while shared executable proof changes.

gates.requiredScope: Canonical Coverlet collection keeps all five required framework assemblies at or above 70 percent line coverage.
gates.rationale: Repository merge policy requires the five-assembly coverage gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if the Constitution and repository gate are formally changed.

gates.requiredScope: DocFX builds with zero warnings/errors and Playwright/Axe documentation smoke passes.
gates.rationale: Ten learner-facing guides and public example documentation change.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if no learner-facing, XML, or DocFX surface changes.

gates.requiredScope: Ubuntu runner executes the repository Release and example acceptance body.
gates.rationale: Runnable terminal examples must remain cross-platform.

gates.requiredScope: macOS runner executes the repository Release and example acceptance body.
gates.rationale: macOS is a primary development and runtime platform.

gates.requiredScope: Windows runner executes the repository Release/example body and PowerShell parity checks.
gates.rationale: Windows compatibility and validator parity are repository requirements.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while executable examples or autonomous state are delivered.

gates.requiredScope: Repository dependency, secret, and supply-chain checks pass on the reviewed head.
gates.rationale: NIST SSDF and repository delivery governance remain applicable.

gates.requiredScope: All five maintained agent guidance surfaces are semantically synchronized.
gates.rationale: Feature and next-step status changes affect maintained context.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if no shared guidance or active-feature marker changes.

gates.requiredScope: No new or changed repository script requires Bash/PowerShell parity.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any added or changed .sh or .ps1 file.
